reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduleAmount, but recomputes the 7.5% rounded tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) is a verbatim copy of getApproxNumberThreshold, so the matching and planning tolerances can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount and each server caller only forwards its operator.

scope.why: Limited to the amount helper, forwarding the op at its five call sites, and tests.

maintainability.why: Single definition with an op parameter is easy to follow, but the duplicated tolerance constant and the stale doc comment (still describing only ranges) add risk.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts recomputes the approximate-amount tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is copied verbatim, not disguised.

one_place.where: The worst-case rule for approximate amounts is added only to getScheduleAmount, which all server planning paths (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) call with the op; only the tolerance formula is duplicated from rules.ts.
